_comment: Measurements taken on the development machine (RTX 5070 Ti Laptop 12 GB,
Ryzen AI 9 HX 370, 31 GB RAM) with llama.cpp build 10675.
vram_gb is the nvidia-smi delta from idle with the model loaded.
tok_s is steady-state generation throughput, averaged over the final
3 of 10 runs with distinct prompts (see harness for why that matters).
These exist so the analytical model can be checked against reality
rather than against itself. A memory model that has never been
confronted with measurements is a guess with extra steps.

machine.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU

known_effects._comment: Findings a naive tuner would get wrong. Regression targets.

ncmoe_is_a_sharp_peak.implication: Bayesian/TPE search assuming a smooth surface can converge into the wrong basin. Search must sample the neighbourhood of any candidate optimum.

warmup_is_load_bearing.detail: Identical config measured 38.39 and 51.04 depending on how many generations preceded it. Steady state needed ~7 runs on a 26 GB MoE.
warmup_is_load_bearing.implication: Fixed warmup counts are wrong in both directions. Detect convergence.

ngram_memorises_repeated_prompts.detail: spec-type ngram-mod scored 176 tok/s by replaying its own output when the same prompt was reused. Dropped to parity with distinct prompts.
ngram_memorises_repeated_prompts.implication: Every repetition must use a distinct prompt.

cross_run_contamination.detail: 20 GB of experts needed longer than 4s for the OS to reclaim; the next config measured low.
cross_run_contamination.implication: Gate each trial on a free-memory precondition, not a fixed sleep.

silent_vram_spill.detail: llama.cpp places KV in system RAM when VRAM is short. No error, roughly half speed. Observed at 48k/f16 (17.75 tok/s), 96k/q8 (15.61), 131k/q4 with ub512 (7.27).
silent_vram_spill.implication: Signature is VRAM pinned at cap + RAM climbing + throughput collapse. Such configs must be rejected, not recorded.

published_advice_was_wrong_here.detail: --spec-draft-p-min 0.60-0.75 is widely recommended for bandwidth-constrained setups; it cost 3-4 tok/s at every value tested. The published n-max 16 / p-min 0.8 recipe was the worst speculative config measured.
published_advice_was_wrong_here.implication: Heuristics from documentation are hypotheses, not defaults.

_comment: Properties read from the real file with toktuner.gguf and
toktuner.tensors while it was on disk. Embedded so the
validation runs anywhere, not only where the model happens
